Interface UcumSymbols

All Known Implementing Classes:
UcumEssence, UcumUnits
public interface UcumSymbols
What the grammar and the reduction need to know about UCUM's atoms and prefixes: which codes exist, which atoms take a prefix, what each atom reduces to, and what each prefix multiplies by. The unmodified UCUM file answers at import time; the store answers afterwards.
